parameters.name: AllKeyPrefix
parameters.description: Specifies whether to match all prefixes. If this parameter is set to true, the KeyPrefixList parameter does not take effect.

parameters.name: DecompressMaxFileCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of files to decompress. The minimum value is 1 and the maximum value is 1000. When the maximum number of decompressed files is exceeded, the decompression operation ends immediately. The detection of files that have already been decompressed is not affected.

parameters.name: DecompressMaxLayer
parameters.description: The maximum number of decompression layers when multiple levels of compressed packages are nested. The minimum value is 1 and the maximum value is 5. When the maximum number of decompression layers is exceeded, the decompression operation ends immediately. The detection of files that have already been decompressed is not affected.

parameters.name: ExcludeKeySuffixList
parameters.description: The list of file suffixes to exclude from detection.

parameters.name: LastModifiedStartTime
parameters.description: Specifies that only files whose last modification time is after the specified timestamp are detected. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: ScanMode
parameters.description:
The detection mode. Valid values:

- **1**: Full file detection.

- **2**: Incremental file detection.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The business source. Valid values:
- **OSS**: OSS
- **NAS**: NAS
